subject.title: WhatsApp: Backfill missed messages after reconnection

question: Should WhatsApp reconnect recovery go beyond the current bounded Baileys `append` handling, and if so should it be backfill, warning-only diagnostics, active liveness probing, or a combined policy?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but processing provider history touches privacy, read receipts, stale auto-replies, dedupe, config/defaults, and live WhatsApp behavior that automation cannot safely choose without maintainer intent.

options.title: Combined recovery policy
options.body: Add a plugin-owned policy with active post-reconnect liveness, bounded monitored-chat history handling where reliable, durable dedupe, and clear warnings when messages cannot be recovered.

options.title: Warn-only first
options.body: Add status/log diagnostics for likely missed inbound gaps without attempting history replay until natural reconnect history behavior is proven live.

options.title: Declare append scope sufficient
options.body: Keep the current bounded append catch-up as the supported behavior and explicitly close provider-side backfill as out of scope.

recommendation.title: Combined recovery policy
recommendation.body: Add a plugin-owned policy with active post-reconnect liveness, bounded monitored-chat history handling where reliable, durable dedupe, and clear warnings when messages cannot be recovered.

likelyOwner.reason: The recent partial-fix authorship and explicit issue comment make this the best available owner for the remaining recovery-policy choice.
